segments.caption: A shirtless young man is shown in his room, waking up at 8:15 AM as indicated by a digital clock, and begins his morning routine by putting on his pants.
A young man in his bedroom is seen putting on a light blue shirt while sitting on the floor in a split position, then stands up to face the camera.

A man in a light-colored shirt is captured in a series of shaky, handheld shots as he moves quickly and erratically through a room, suggesting a state of urgency or panic. The camera follows his motion closely, blurring the background which includes a wooden door, a window with a metal grille, and wooden cabinets, indicating an indoor, domestic setting. His rapid movement and the unstable camera work convey a sense of haste or disorientation as he navigates the space.
A young man in a school uniform and backpack is seen in an elevator, then boards a bus at a roadside stop, suggesting he is commuting to or from school.
A young man with a backpack walks from a bus stop into a subway station, passes through a turnstile, and then bends over on the platform, appearing to be in discomfort or pain.

A person with a backpack is seen in a train station, bending over before swiftly moving through a covered walkway and then jumping down a short flight of stairs onto a grassy area, suggesting a quick, purposeful exit from the station.
A person with a backpack performs a dynamic parkour sequence, vaulting over a low wall and a concrete ledge before landing gracefully on a paved plaza in front of a multi-story building.

A person in a light-colored outfit and backpack performs a dynamic parkour sequence in an urban environment, leaping over a low wall and vaulting over a higher concrete wall, showcasing agility and fluid movement against the backdrop of residential buildings and paved walkways.

A person is seen scaling a high brick wall, then successfully vaulting over it to land on a paved rooftop area. After a brief moment, they run across the rooftop and descend a set of stairs, continuing their movement through the campus-like environment.

A person is seen ascending a series of outdoor staircases and ramps, moving through an urban environment that includes modern buildings, a covered pedestrian bridge, and greenery, indicating a journey through a city's public infrastructure.
A person with a backpack runs up a set of outdoor stairs and continues running down a tree-lined path.
A young man in school uniform walks down a tree-lined path, then stops and turns to look back over his shoulder with a startled expression as he adjusts his tie.

A young man in a school uniform, carrying a backpack, walks through a sunlit, open-air campus courtyard. He pauses in the center of the paved area, which features decorative patterns, and appears to be speaking or reacting to something, suggesting he is engaged in a conversation or an important moment.

A student in a school uniform stands in a large, ornately tiled courtyard, gesturing emphatically as he speaks. As he talks, animated text overlays appear beside him, listing the days of the week, suggesting he is explaining or debating a schedule, likely related to school or his weekly routine.

A young man in a school uniform and glasses, carrying a backpack, walks confidently through a modern school courtyard, his expression and gestures suggesting he is speaking or performing. The video opens with his face in focus, then transitions to title cards crediting the cast and crew as he walks away, establishing the scene and introducing the creative team behind the video.

The video opens with credit text overlaid on a blurred, out-of-focus shot of a person walking away from the camera down a tiled walkway framed by pillars and greenery. The credits acknowledge the music by John Paul Balthazar Kwan and the camera operators.
